{{Top|leg}}
'''Picomith''' was a settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Chelloa]]. It was one of the few to survive the large population drop after the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] took over the planet.
